_about: Raising-depth fragment (List 30 #293) — Chao-grade depth annexed to #28's care profile. THE LINE: raising never changes battle stats; the effect-record schema has no field capable of naming one. Defence is argued in the spec (each parent rules its own house; a fed Mochi is a thriving Mochi, not a stronger one).

alignment_drift.fence: drift is shaping, never damage — #287 closure never results from ordinary raising; abuse-class facts are #287's separate gate
alignment_drift.inputs: acts at the act: who raises, treatment facts (care consistency, neglect/praise events) — on #28's existing alignment value; no second store
alignment_drift.reads_against: #271's ladder from the other side — the ladder is what the world thinks of the Ranger; drift-form is what a Mochi's body says about the Ranger
alignment_drift.resolution: at growth moments (#199 evolution, #243 stage boundaries) drift resolves into VISIBLE FORM (posture, feature accents, palette-warmth within species palette law — the Lustre fence stands)
alignment_drift.write: a #80 deviation-class presentation fact — MUST reproduce in every render (#196 law); #202's family gains it as the long ('years') layer over mood's hours

battle_stats_line.claim: raising NEVER changes battle stats — feeding/gifts/care write care-axis values only (Garden life + #294 care sports); battle stats remain species base + #80 variance + #39 effort + #178 growth, earned in battle/training, read by #17
defence: base rule: Pokémon governs battle (its fairness is a public promise — #109 lobby, facilities), Chao governs the Garden (raising IS the game there); neither colonises the other
if feeding moved battle stats, battles would silently price grocery labour — an invisible bend, forbidden in shape by #180's law — and the Garden would become optimisation homework instead of care
enforcement is schema-level: the care effect record has NO field capable of naming a battle stat

checkups.grades: letter-class per care axis (documented E..S shape; bands are data) — written as dated record facts at #132 checkups only
checkups.use: grades scale how fast an axis learns from later gifts (multiplier table is data)

feeding.care_item_class: proposed into #31's home — taste data (axes spoken to, strength, per-sheet palate: liked/neutral/disliked) + effect record
feeding.effect_record: axis deltas (small, per-act cap — data) + #28 drive refills + a history beat, written to the care profile at the act
feeding.found_gifts: habitat-carried items (#66) work identically with wilder variance — a found gift's lean is discovered by giving

lessons: a facility class teaching BEHAVIOURS (dances, greetings, bearing) into the individual's #152 stocked pool over time — repertoire, never stats; contents are world content
